events.event_name: Max Mara Le Parfum x Macy’s Sampling
events.what_it_is: An open-air Max Mara Le Parfum launch pop-up outside Macy’s Herald Square with an interactive scent experience, games and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary gelato, fragrance samples and chances at giveaways, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Eventbrite is organizer-posted by Max Mara. The listing advertises tickets but does not establish organizer approval or a paid admission requirement.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–6 PM at Macy’s Herald Square Plaza. Samples, gelato and giveaways are while supplies last.

events.event_name: Cafe Yaeji: Free Oatly Gochujang Lattes
events.what_it_is: A two-day immersive café inspired by Korean dabangs and Yaeji’s creative world.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary iced Gochujang Lattes made with Oatly Barista Edition.
events.caveats: No advance RSVP requirement was published in the verified listings. Complimentary drinks are promotional and may be capacity/supply limited.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19 and Sunday Sept. 20, 9 AM–3 PM each day at 48 Ludlow Street.

events.what_it_is: A weekend reopening celebration for Credo Beauty’s SoHo boutique with gifts and in-store raffles.
events.what_is_free: A complimentary gift for the first 150 guests each day with no purchase required, plus no-purchase-required product raffles. A separate gift with purchase is offered for $100+ purchases.
events.caveats: RSVP is explicitly not required and does not guarantee gift eligibility. Gifts are first-come, first-served and while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19: 11 AM–7 PM. Sept. 20: 11 AM–6 PM. Credo’s current store listing independently confirms the SoHo address at 9 Prince Street.

events.what_it_is: A launch pop-up for the Magnolia Bakery x LONDONTOWN nail lakur collection.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 customers in line receive a free banana pudding dessert and lakur.
events.caveats: Free items are limited to the first 100 customers in line. No advance RSVP requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 11 AM–1 PM at Magnolia Bakery, 401 Bleecker Street.

events.what_it_is: A La Mer activation at Bloomingdale’s SoHo tied to the reformulated Concentrate launch.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary ice cream and a complimentary sample of the new Concentrate with a personalized Skin by La Mer experience.
events.caveats: Bloomingdale’s officially confirms La Mer ice cream carts on Sept. 19. Secondary current listings specify the SoHo activation window as 2–6 PM. Promotional items are subject to availability.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 2–6 PM at Bloomingdale’s SoHo, 504 Broadway.
